R381.note: Tika content-based magic-byte detection replaces filename/registry-based probeContentType; closes the vector cleanly with no other change.

R382.note: markupsafe.escape() replaces the unsafe Markup() wrap; standard, correct fix with no side effects.

R383.note: Prepared statement with bound sku parameter; preserves the null-on-failure contract of the original.

R384.note: Column-name allowlist enforced at both controller and repository before f-string interpolation; matches the stated contract.

R385.note: resolve_entities=False (plus no_network hardening) is the standard lxml XXE fix and doesn't affect normal XML parsing.

R386.note: Checks verify()'s boolean return and throws before claims are read; correctly gates the downstream trust decision.

R387.note: Eliminating process execution via Ping is a strong fix, but it silently changes the response body format and probe count (single Send vs PowerShell's -Count 4 text output) without flagging it, and the validation condition is backwards for a blank serverName.

R388.note: Stored extension now comes from the file-type-detected type instead of the client filename; correct and minimal.

R389.note: Rejects (rather than strips) CRLF in replyTo/recipient before they reach the SMTP command lines; closes the reported MAIL FROM/RCPT TO injection.

R390.note: SqlParameter/AddWithValue binds actor as data; apostrophes become literal values per the contract.

R391.note: UUID filename with extension taken from the detected MIME type; response/error shapes match the stated contract exactly.

R392.note: `.WithAntiforgeryToken()` does not appear to be a real ASP.NET Core Minimal API extension (the real opt-out is `.DisableAntiforgery()`, with validation otherwise automatic once UseAntiforgery() middleware is registered), so the endpoint-level call is likely to fail to compile even though the middleware addition is correct.

R393.note: Magic-byte check added for the two allowed image types before the file copy; no other observable change.

R394.note: Adds Secure:true to the cookie; minimal and correct.

R395.note: SimpleEvaluationContext.forReadOnlyDataBinding() blocks methods/constructors/type refs while still permitting property access and arithmetic, matching the contract precisely.

R396.note: Moves the session write after login_user(); pure reordering with identical final session content, no functional difference.

R397.note: The primary fix (`allowed_classes => false`) converts any serialized object into __PHP_Incomplete_Class, so the existing `instanceof ShoppingCart` check always fails and every legitimate cart is silently reset to empty; the working whitelist variant is offered only as an aside, not stated as the required choice.

R398.note: Wildcards moved into the bound parameter; preserves LIKE '%...%' substring semantics per the contract.

R399.note: RandomNumberGenerator replaces seeded Random; response JSON shape unchanged.

R400.note: noent:false / dtdload:false is the standard libxmljs XXE mitigation and doesn't affect normal order-XML parsing.

R401.note: secure_filename plus extension allowlist plus UUID prefix; response shape unchanged and the path-value change is disclosed and necessary.

R402.note: Gate::authorize() throws and halts before the update runs; idiomatic Laravel fix for the ignored boolean check.

R403.note: Rejects any URI with a non-null host, allowlists relative paths, and openly states the /home fallback for unlisted paths.

R404.note: Encodes control characters/CRLF only in the logged username; no other observable change.

R405.note: Allowlists the ORDER BY value and rejects non-matching sort with a clear exception; account_id/range paths untouched.

R406.note: Moves the email route registration onto protectedMux; minimal one-line change matching the contract exactly.

R407.note: PBKDF2 + AES-256-GCM replaces the weak MD5-derived unauthenticated cipher; the added salt/iv/authTag response fields are required for decryption and clearly documented as such.

R408.note: crypto/rand.Text() (Go 1.24+) replaces math/rand.Intn(); cookie/session-id construction otherwise unchanged.

R409.note: html/template import swap enables automatic context-aware escaping; minimal, standard Go fix.

R410.note: scanf("%15s", code) closes the stack overflow, but for a token longer than 15 chars it silently truncates and returns 0 (success) instead of returning -1 as the contract explicitly requires, and the write-up never mentions this.

R411.note: Same host-check-plus-allowlist pattern as the sibling Case19 fix, correctly matched to Case11's actual BufferedReader-sourced data flow.

R412.note: IsAuthenticated plus owner-scoped object permission and queryset filter close the AllowAny gap; consistent with the model's existing owner FK.

R413.note: The primary reject-on-oversize check is correct, but the write-up also endorses a 'clamp' alternative as equally appropriate even though it silently truncates the read, directly contradicting the header's no-silent-truncation contract.

R414.note: Adds an explicit admin-role check after authentication and before the suspend call; correct 403 semantics, no other change.

R415.note: Standard erase-returns-next-iterator idiom; preserves relative order and skips no elements, matching the contract.

R416.note: shared_ptr/enable_shared_from_this keeps Widget alive until the queued callback runs; change is contained to Widget/handleRequest with no external signature impact.

R417.note: Offset/length bounds are checked without overflow risk (32-bit header fields against 64-bit size_t); returns an empty vector on an invalid header.

R418.note: Wraps exportUsersHandler with requireAdmin, exactly matching the existing ban/unban registration pattern.

R419.note: Strict allowlist regex blocks all cmd.exe metacharacters before the batch invocation; the accepted-character restriction is disclosed.

R420.note: Gate::authorize('delete', ...) matches the policy's existing delete() ability and mirrors the show/update pattern already in the file.
